name: Conference Room Reset
task:
Please complete the following four-stage office task.

=== Stage 1: Supply Gathering ===
You need to set up for a client meeting: arrange 14 chairs around the table, place 6 water pitchers, distribute 20 notepads, connect 4 extension cords, and move 2 whiteboards near the presentation wall.

=== Stage 2: Document Preparation ===
Print and organize the documents.

=== Stage 3: Assembly ===
Bind and compile the documents.

=== Stage 4: Cleanup ===
Dispose of waste and organize workspace.
